overview: Dissolve and erosion materials should communicate a single readable coverage progression, a controlled edge frontier, and secondary breakup that never fights the main progress mask.
common_failure_modes: emissive flooding ahead of the coverage mask
edge width changing so much that the frontier stops reading cleanly
capture_review_checklist: Front shot shows a single clear transition frontier.
Three-quarter shot preserves breakup while keeping the coverage read intact.
Grazing shot keeps the edge visible without turning into a full-surface glow.
